meta.name: Door
meta.description: Vehicle door lock and door state module, instantiated for each actual side door or tailgate. Supports locking, unlocking, and querying lock state, door opening/closing state, and closure feedback; a locked door is not necessarily closed. The base class does not provide powered opening or closing; manual operation is updated through local environment actions. Door opening and closing contribute to exchange between the corresponding Space and the outside.

locked.description: Whether the door lock is engaged. This state does not imply that the door is physically closed.

door_state.description: Physical door position reported by local manual environment actions.

closure_feedback.description: Whether the door is fully closed and latched. Manual environment actions set this to true only after complete closure.

get_locked.description: Return whether the door lock is engaged. The result does not indicate whether the door is physically closed.

locked.description: Whether the door lock is engaged.

lock.description: Engage the door lock without changing the physical door position or closure feedback. The action is idempotent and may be used even when the door is open or ajar.

unlock.description: Disengage the door lock without changing the physical door position or closure feedback. The action is idempotent.

get_door_state.description: Return the manually reported physical door position: closed, ajar, or open. This function does not move the door.

door_state.description: Physical door position: closed, ajar, or open.

get_closure_feedback.description: Return whether the door is fully closed and latched. This feedback is independent of the lock state.

closure_feedback.description: Whether the door is fully closed and latched.

manual_open.description: Record a local manual action that places the door in the fully open position. This is not a powered opening command. The door state and closure feedback are updated atomically, and the lock state is unchanged.

manual_set_ajar.description: Record a local manual action that leaves the door partially closed or unlatched. This is not a powered movement command. The door state and closure feedback are updated atomically, and the lock state is unchanged.

manual_close.description: Record a local manual action that fully closes and latches the door. This is not a powered closing command. The door state and closure feedback are updated atomically, and the lock state is unchanged.

tick.description: For a seat-mounted door, use the cabin space resolved by type; for a trunk or cargo door, use its own space. Each minute while closure_feedback is false, move the corresponding interior Space temperature and noise fully to the current exterior values to represent exchange through the unsealed opening. When closure_feedback is true, produce no exchange effect.

effect_properties.name: closure_feedback
effect_properties.description: Determines whether the door is sealed or permits exchange with the exterior.
